تستفزوا (form X)
# تَسْتَفِزُّوا (tastafizzū) /tas.ta.fiz.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
# تُسْتَفَزُّوا (tustafazzū) /tus.ta.faz.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
